scope: Static inspection of an official D11 Pro comparison image, not a Fichero D11s firmware dump. No hardware update, bootloader entry or command testing performed.

fichero_api.result: HTTP success response with no firmware data/media/download URL for tested D11s selectors, the bundled catalog UUID, an unfiltered request, and one related FICHERO_6181/A40 selector. This does not establish that no firmware exists or that exact device identifiers/authentication cannot change the result.

format.load_address_evidence: APK UpdatePrinterESC default start address and internal code pointers such as 0x0102e26d at file offset 0x100 agree.
format.compression: The downloaded ZIP contains one raw .bin with directly decodable code; no unpacking/decryption needed for reviewed functions.

findings.applicability: Confirms sample identity, not D11s compatibility.

findings.details: Main interpreter consumes 10, tests FF, dispatches on third byte. FE selects handler consuming 01 or 45. 01 sets job state; 45 updates deferred completion state. No per-raster-packet acknowledgement was established.
findings.applicability: Consistent with audited AiYin print sequence, not evidence of an additional mandatory handshake.

findings.finding: Unsolicited FF nn fault/status change report
findings.details: Loads FF 00 template; substitutes byte 1 with a state byte when changed; sends length 2 through selected transport independently of query handling. Sensor meanings are from the APK audit, not independently proven by naming this firmware routine.
findings.applicability: Supports keeping an always-active event decoder. Exact D11s implementation still requires its image or hardware traces.

findings.finding: Bounded shared receive ring with high-water handling
findings.details: Ring storage at RAM 0x00025374, indices modulo 0x6000 (24576). Blocking producer waits at occupancy 0x5fff. Another producer has high-water handling above 0x4ccc, calls 0x0102fab8, and returns 2 at 0x5fc0. Consumer clears a congestion latch below 0x3999 and calls 0x0102faa4.
findings.applicability: Explains need for bounded streaming/backpressure; internal thresholds are not a verified BLE credit format or safe D11s burst size.

findings.finding: Bounded wait for command parameter bytes
findings.details: Receive-byte helper waits in 2-tick steps with retry counter >0x12c returning -1. Tick duration not established.
findings.applicability: Long pauses inside commands may exceed parser wait bounds; not a measured D11s timeout.

findings.details: Consumes one byte, computes OR and AND of its nibbles, sends one byte. APK updater uses this command, but it is not in the normal D11s print initialization path.
findings.applicability: Comparison-image static result; not tested on printer and not required by this audit.

findings.details: 10 FF 20 dispatches to identity responses containing V1.00, D11 Pro and 2.3.4.

limitations: Linear disassembly includes data and compiler switch tables that can appear as instructions. Findings use manually traced entry points, branches and literal loads; this is not a complete recovered source tree.
No D11s firmware image obtained. No claim of binary compatibility, exhaustive command coverage or root cause of the earlier physical disconnect.
FF 10 discarding-data payload semantics remain unresolved.
No runtime Labeler changes or publication made. Firmware and disassembly stay outside the repository.
